title: Maikura Blueprint
description: In-game blueprint system with previews, builder anchors, storage, hopper input, and WorldEdit .schem support.
body:
Maikura Blueprint adds an in-game blueprint workflow for saving, previewing, and building structures.

## Features

- In-game blueprint catalog
- MBP and WorldEdit `.schem` support
- Blueprint preview modes for shape, manual placement, obstacles, and missing blocks
- Builder Anchor system
- Material Storage linked to each Anchor
- Hopper input into Storage
- Auto-clear support for many natural blocks
- Water auto-clear behavior
- Japanese UI labels

## Auto-clear behavior

Natural terrain and plant blocks are generally treated as auto-clear targets.

Protected or functional blocks such as ores, chests, bee nests, turtle eggs, hoppers, furnaces, and similar blocks remain obstacles.

Water is auto-cleared without storage recovery. Lava keeps manual/safety behavior.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
